recalled_knowledge.item: Higgs vev v = 246.2 GeV; M_Planck = 1.22e19 GeV
Z coupling of a fermion (g/c_W)(T_3 - Q s_W^2); nucleon vector charges g_V^p = (1-4 s_W^2)/4, g_V^n = -1/4
One-loop electroweak mass splitting formula Delta m = (alpha_2 M/4pi){(Q^2-Q'^2) s_W^2 f(m_Z/M) + (Q-Q')(Q+Q'-2Y)[f(m_W/M)-f(m_Z/M)]}, heavy limit (alpha_2/2)[...]
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Cirelli, Fornengo, Strumia, NPB 753, 178 (2006); reproduced P014's values

recalled_knowledge.item: Fermion multiplets with n >= 6 make g_2 non-perturbative below M_Pl (quintuplet is the largest MDM fermion)
Y != 0 electroweak multiplets are excluded by Z-exchange elastic scattering unless the neutral Dirac state is split
Thermal relic mass of the pure Higgsino doublet 1.1 TeV
Thermal wino (3,0) 2.7-3.0 TeV; quintuplet (5,0) 9.4 TeV with Sommerfeld
Thermal masses of (3,1) ~ 2 TeV, (4,1/2) and (4,3/2) ~ 2.4 TeV, (5,1) and (5,2) ~ 4.5 TeV
LZ 2024 SI limit ~ 5e-47 cm^2 at 1 TeV
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: LZ 2024 WS result (as recalled by P007)

recalled_knowledge.item: Chargino -> neutralino + pion width proportional to kappa^2 f_pi^2 Delta m^3 (used only as a scaling of P014's ctau)
Hill-Solon loop-level sigma_SI 1e-49 - 1e-47 cm^2 for electroweak multiplets (mentioned, unused quantitatively)
Remarks in the MDM literature that certain Y != 0 multiplets have a charged lightest component
recalled_knowledge.reliability: uncertain (our own computation is used; the literature attribution is tentative)

failed_or_abandoned: First chargino-lifetime scaling gave a negative ctau for the (5,1) Q=-1 state (which is lighter than the neutral one); replaced by a NaN plus an explicit 'lighter than neutral' flag and a brentq solve for the (4,1/2) crossing mass (1361 GeV).
A full WimPyDD recomputation of N(m, delta) for each Y was not done: the (2Y)^2 scaling is exact (identical c_p/c_n) and was verified live at four points to 1e-4.
Figure label collisions (fig. 1 tick labels, fig. 2 M_DM caption on the gridline) fixed in two iterations.
